question: Do higher short-only multiples change account growth or violate maintenance/drawdown when long leverage remains fixed at 1.5x?
single_variable: Against the 1.5x/1.5x frozen 360-name account, vary only shorts to 2x or 3x. Use the same native stops and hourly true-notional cap. Reject a multiple if a real source path hits the study's isolated 10% maintenance boundary. No per-symbol exception.
costs: Same two-sided fees and 5bp adverse market-slippage scenario, historical funding missing. The symmetric long-only leverage experiment has already been inspected.
